videos.title: 多隔层通勤包翻包
videos.author: pppaaais
videos.zh: 看作者怎样用随身物件介绍分区。换成你的包，选一张门卡，拍手伸进两个不同隔层的全过程。
videos.en: Notice how everyday objects explain the compartments. Film the same pass being retrieved from two different pockets.

videos.title: 七日商务出差通勤都装了什么？
videos.author: 关山牧书
videos.zh: 借用「一次出差」给装包设限。换成下班逛书店，只给原来的通勤清单多加一本书。
videos.en: Give the packing list a trip with a purpose. Try one bookshop stop and add exactly one book to your usual carry.

videos.title: 出门带娃／通勤的多功能背包
videos.author: 森诺箱包工厂店
videos.zh: 评论里有人问能否装电脑。把手头的电脑或书当作固定参照物，拍清放进去后拉链能否拉上。
videos.en: A viewer asks whether a laptop fits. Use your own laptop or book for scale and keep the zip in frame as you try to close it.

videos.title: 好天气里的敲击音：把包里的小东西们一顿敲
videos.author: SasAta飒飒塔
videos.zh: 原片把包里物件的声音当作主角。你的版本可以先让观众听，再揭晓是哪两件东西碰在一起。
videos.en: Use the sound of objects from the bag as the subject. Play the sound first, then reveal the pair that made it.

videos.title: 台灯应放身体左边 or 右边？
videos.author: 腾讯QQfamily儿童台灯
videos.zh: 借用左右摆灯的问题。保持书页、笔和曝光不动，只换灯的位置，比较同一个字旁边的手影。
videos.en: Borrow the left-or-right question. Keep the page, pen and exposure fixed, move only the lamp and compare the shadow beside the same word.

videos.title: 孩视宝台灯放在书桌或床头柜
videos.author: 青鸾小店
videos.zh: 原片把书桌和床头柜列作两个使用位置。把你的桌面边界贴出来，让观众看到灯、书、水杯各占了多少地方。
videos.en: The source considers a desk and a bedside table. Mark the edges of your surface and show how much room the lamp, book and glass use.

videos.title: 17 款平价宿舍磁吸灯横评
videos.author: 小白的家电日记
videos.zh: 参考宿舍熄灯后的用灯场景。用同一部手机轮流拍书页和隔壁枕头，让观众看到两个位置的差别。
videos.en: Borrow the dorm lighting scenario. Move one phone between the page and the neighbouring pillow so the audience sees both views.

videos.title: 小鹰日光 13L 背包与侧网兜取壶
videos.author: 猫叔奶糖
videos.zh: 原片提到从侧网兜取水壶。加一把折伞，拍两种装法下那只拿水的手要走多远。
videos.en: The creator describes taking a bottle from a side pocket. Add a folding umbrella and record how far the reaching hand travels in each layout.

videos.title: These 9 Backpacks Fit Your Massive Water Bottles
videos.author: Backpackies
videos.zh: 参考用实物检查水瓶和侧袋能否配合。拍自己的杯子时把杯口、袋口和手放在同一个画面里。
videos.en: Borrow the real bottle-to-pocket fit test. Keep the bottle, pocket opening and your hand in one frame.

videos.title: Measuring volume in milliliters and liters
videos.author: Math Mammoth
videos.zh: 原片用量杯测饮水杯的容量。你的版本可以倒满一排同款小杯，把最后没满的那杯也留下来。
videos.en: The lesson measures drinking cups with a measuring cup. Try a row of identical small cups and keep the partly filled last one in the shot.

videos.title: 多功能杯刷清洗杯子边角
videos.author: 炒级棒棒糖
videos.zh: 参考长柄刷接触杯壁的用法。拍自己这只杯的时候，把刷子和杯子并排，让观众先猜能否够到底。
videos.en: Borrow the long-handled brush demonstration. Show your brush next to the bottle and let viewers guess if it reaches the base.
